a-mistaken-marriage-match-mysteries-in-t:
He is the master of six kingdoms. As long as he wanted, his cavalry is ready to wipe off any country.
She is the world renowned talented Qing Family sisters. But because of his word, her family became destitute and homeless. He wanted to tame her, she will not submit to him.
Two similar unbending persons with no love and feelings between them, are fated to be continuously intertwine an entire lifetime. He thought that he wanted her total submission but when she was kneeling at his feet, why did it all feel meaningless?
She thought that all she wanted was his life, but when he spurted blood while he was lying in her arms and asked “Why did you return?” Why did her tears keep falling?
Various mysteries in imperial harem, a gold heist, a case of dead palace maid, the baffling death of a young prince, the secret around crown prince’s parentage... So many secrets and thrills!
adventures-of-the-last-wild-dragon:
What happens when a baby dragon is born with no one to look out for it in its infancy.
How will this dragon that doesn’t even have a name survive when thrust into a competition for supremacy by the system on the day she is born?
How about when rumours of a true wild dragon being born reach the civilised world, threatening a millennia of careful control over the subjugated species.
What will this baby dragon have to do to survive in a world that wants to either eat or capture her.
How about when she saves a young leopard Beastkin? What will develop between these two young girls as they are forced to adapt and survive the the harsh wilderness that is constantly evolving around them.
Well the answer is quite simple for our little dragon. she just needs to get stronger and eat whatever challenges her and her companion first.
Join our lovable little terror as she navigates a dangerous world. eats tasty enemies and grows stronger with both might and magic.
apocalypse-villainess-transmigrates-into:
Getting shoved into a horde of zombies by a group of spineless survivors was not how Hana expected to die.
Then again, neither was dying as the most notorious villainess among them—the kind who used people without hesitation and discarded them just as easily.
An unflashy, pathetic end.
She deserved it… didn’t she?
But the universe wasn’t done with her yet.
Hana wakes up in a completely different world with a system notification she can’t ignore:
Karma Points: -1,250,000
To survive past one month, she must bring it back to zero.
No shortcuts. No cheats. No killing.
Just… being a ‘good’ person.
“…You’ve got to be kidding me.”
As if that wasn’t bad enough, during her quests, she keeps picking up strays—dangerous, powerful, clingy strays.
“Hana, you need to pay attention to me today.” The dragon beastman murmured, crowding into her space.
“No way, Hana promised to cuddle me,” the nine-tailed fox added sweetly, offering her a flower.
“What nonsense? Hana said she would fly with me,” the falcon beastman cut in, wings twitching.
“You’re all delusional.” The snow leopard beastman scoffed, tail flicking lazily. “Hana already made plans with me.…
as-a-magnate-i-started-checking-in-at-a-:
After graduation, Zhou Chao went home and inherited the convenience store his parents left behind. He also received a Check-in System.
[Ding! You have obtained a newbie gift pack x1.]
[Do you want to open it?]
“Open the newbie gift pack,” Zhou Chao said as he leaned back in his chair.
Upon opening the gift pack, he received a Wuling Hongguang MINI EV and 1 million yuan in cash….
ashen-dragon:
The Red Dragon came from the vast wild wastes, coveting all the strength in the world. It once had countless titles: Mountain's Wrathful Flame, Infernal Calamity, Crimson Emperor, Ashen Dragon......
The world trembled under the shadow of the giant dragons. He stirred up the craze of the magic industrial revolution; in the empire he established, Wyverns roared, artillery fired in unison, and steel beasts appeared in the sky and on the land, while disasters from another world rampaged everywhere.
“Submit, or die.”
Cassius spread his wings, blotting out the sun, and gazed down at the trembling humans, elves, and dwarves below, saying thus.
......
It is a story about a Red Dragon with a player template conquering, ruling, and transforming an alternate world.
(Pseudo of DnD, The Fourth Calamity, Red Dragon)
awakening-domination-system-but-im-a-sla:
Betrayed by his beloved queen.
Stabbed by the very men he raised to power.
King Alaric died with a broken heart… and a blade in his chest.
Fate’s twisted joke?
He’s reborn—in chains.
Collared. Beaten. Sold like cattle.
Once a mighty ruler. Now a slave in a world of magic, monsters, and bastards with crowns.
His new master? Arrogant with even little much money, and the personality of a wet cabbage.
And the wife?
Let’s just say... she deserves better. Much better.
Just when he thought a future of licking boots and scrubbing chamber pots—
[DING! You have awakened the Domination System.]
Rule the strong. Break the proud. Tap the wife. Steal the life.
“I—wait, what?”
[New Quest: Subjugate your Master's Wife.]
[Reward: +500 Power | Domination Skill Unlocked – Command Voice]
[Bonus: Do it on the master’s bed for extra EXP.]
He grins through the pain, eyes burning with ambition.
They thought they broke him?
They just gave him a reason to rise.
Power. Revenge. Pleasure.
He’ll take it all.
------------------
Note- No ntr, no yuri.
Mc won't abandon his women, neither he will force them, and not every women will be subjugated.…
awoke-as-a-god-after-auto-battling-for-1:
When the rifts between worlds opened, countless monsters flooded through, engulfing human cities and plunging the world into chaos. Faced with this apocalyptic crisis, humanity was forced into a new era where every individual had to choose a profession. Nations now compete to cultivate elite practitioners, striving for supremacy in the rankings of alternate world conquests.
But as the world teeters on the brink, the first and greatest champion awakens after a million years of slumber—armed with untold buff amassed from his millennia of AFK grinding.
The bosses of the otherworld tremble in fear. Global T0-ranked powerhouses bow down, offering their loyalty...
[Disclaimer: Here countries fight against each other and this is adapted into a Manhua.]
[Schedule: 2 Chapters/Day]
daoism-revival-system-start-with-fightin:
Traveling to a parallel world where demons reawaken, Lin Heng becomes a Daoist and is tangled with the eerie Life-Buying Money.
One day, ten years of life are borrowed, and as he faces the brink of extinction, fortunately, the system activates!
“Fusion, Five Thunders Righteous Method!”
With the Great Divine Techniques of the Celestial Master's Mansion in hand, Lin Heng awaits the eerie entities coming for his life that night.
douluo-seven-treasure-pagoda-im-actually:
Jiang Bai was unexpectedly reborn in Douluo Continent.
The good news was that his father was a disciple of the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile School; the bad news was that his father chose to leave the school for the sake of his ordinary mother and to pursue free love.
At the age of six, he awakened his martial soul, the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda. Jiang Bai felt hopeless; was he destined to be just a support character?
Until the day he absorbed his first spirit ring…
After absorbing the spirit ring, Jiang Bai saw a chibi-style spirit beast emerge from the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda.
“What is this thing?!”
“I…I’m not dead?!” The man and the beast stared at each other, bewildered.…
Yu Xiaogang: “Become my disciple! Only I can teach you this mutated Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda…”
Jiang Bai: “Get lost.”
Tang San: “Impossible! How can a Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda beat my Clear Sky Hammer!”
Jiang Bai: “Many beasts, great strength!”
Years later…
everyone-knows-im-a-good-person:
Shi Qing’s task was to be a protector.
It was only after transmigrating to various worlds and eagerly counterattacking the villains there that he realized he was the biggest villain out of everyone.
– A King that liked to conquer other worlds
– A Film Emperor that had a malicious personality
– A Blackened Young Master with deviant intentions
– A Schoolyard Bully that was overbearing to others
Afterwards the gong that initially despised Shi Qing discovered:
– The Machine King that seemed like an invader was really a million-year-old baby
– The Film Emperor that seemed malicious was secretly helping upcoming actors
– The Young Master that seemed to harbor deviant intentions was a pure-hearted young boy
– The Schoolyard Bully that seemed overbearing was secretly in love
In the end….
The entire world: He’s such a good person!
fierce-horror-dorm-take-a-concubine-to-g:
When people woke up, they found themselves in a survival game set in a dormitory. Blood-red mist filled the air, and human civilization was on the verge of collapse. The only safe haven was their own dorm room!
Xu Lang awakened the Nightmare Ruler sequence—he could earn Nightmare Coins just by sleeping, and use them to enhance anything.
Even goddesses could increase sleep comfort, boosting the conversion rate of Nightmare Coins!
From the 【Dilapidated Wooden Door】 to the 【Immortal Star Gate】 that could withstand any calamity.
From the 【Electromagnetic Turret】 to the 【Stellar Cannon】 that could obliterate horror emperors.
From the 【Fireball Spell】 to the 【Doomsday Black Flame】 that could burn all things.
From 【Meditation】 to the 【Mystic Lord’s Seven-Chapter Manual】 that could elevate one to godhood.
In this game full of despair, Xu Lang chose to lay low and grow stronger.
help-i-became-a-guy-in-a-bl-novel:
sidelines, cheering for the MCs like the dedicated shipper she is. But plot twist—she’s now a guy. And not just any guy—a ridiculously handsome guy!
After spending an embarrassing amount of time winking at her own reflection and flexing muscles she never had before, she decides, “Why just watch the romance when you can be the romance?” Armed with good looks, charm, and way too much insider knowledge of every trope imaginable, she sets out to conquer every character in the story, including the MC she used to fangirl over.
But wait… Does this make her gay? Or straight? Or just hopelessly in love with her own fictional fantasy? Frankly, she’s too busy causing chaos (and enjoying it) to care.
PS: There is smut, and its reverse harem :3
i-became-a-cub-in-the-elven-kingdom:
What’s it like to transmigrate as a Fairy Cub in the Elven Kingdom?
Tiny, no bigger than a thumb, with a pair of translucent wings on his back, Shu Li drank dew, ate flower nectar, slept in a flower bed, and spent his days playing carefree and blissful. It was pure happiness!
Happiness, my ass. @_@
Unable to learn Elven, he couldn’t even speak. Shu Li had become a veritable mute Little Fairy.
As a former high school senior, Shu Li declared that learning a foreign language was way too hard!
Why hadn’t the Transmigration God granted him a language cheat?
Why did he have to start all over like a baby?
Elven was the most difficult language in the world!
While other Fairy Cubs were already singing, Shu Li was still babbling.
While other Fairy Cubs were reciting poetry, Shu Li was still learning everyday conversation.
While other Fairy Cubs were chanting magic spells, Shu Li was still learning to sing.
Shu Li’s pride suffered a crushing blow.…
interstellar-number-one-farmer-i-only-wa:
Su Xiaocai has crossed over from a more technologically advanced interstellar world for ten years.
In that world, aliens invaded, and wars were frequent. As a warrior on the front line, it was rare to see green plants.
This fostered Su Xiaocai's hobby of planting vegetables and trees.
She vowed to become the best vegetable farmer, far from the battlefield.
Classmates: Who's operating the mecha dancing in the field?
The teacher who heard the rumor rushed over: Not bad, a good seedling.
The principal waved his pen: Transfer her to the Mecha Department.
my-life-with-narration:
Su Qing, who has just graduated and works as a video blogger, mistakenly consumes poisonous mushrooms sent by a fan and awakens an unusual ability: Her life is full of continuous prompts from a narration.
Morning: [Morning has arrived, all things are reviving, and it is the season for animals to mate again.]
Eating: [High-quality ingredients only need the simplest cooking methods. The meal before you has gone bad after fermenting overnight, and consuming it will allow you to experience hospital internet speed in thirty minutes.]
Driving: [Of the millions of roads, safety is the first. If driving is not standardized, relatives will weep.]
[Continue driving, the vehicle will be subjected to a severe impact in three seconds, good luck.]
my-wife-is-actually-a-top-tier-soldier-k:
The overbearing top-notch beauty CEO wife turned out to be the terrifying and formidable War King!!
A voice rose in Wu Jie's mind.
Ding!
[Host becomes familiar with the system rules, sparking the first task: Earn a hundred thousand energy points within a week]
[Task Reward: One hundred thousand bonus points, unlocking the shop, one lottery draw]
[Failure Punishment: Clear all the host's bank savings]
...
“Damn it, I'm going all in!”
“If I win, I'll get the beauties; if I lose, I'll work my hands to the bone! What's there to be afraid of with such a small task? I'll take it!!”
second-genesis:
Everyone wants a second chance until they're trapped in an impossible loop.
Grey wasn't one to lust after redos. He lived life with his heart on his sleeve and a pep in his step, but the universe had other plans for him, plans that started with a knife in the gut and a survival game show warring alien races used to take the edge off.
The good news was that his new Spirit, Prometheus, didn't ask him whether he wanted a redo or not before it yanked his soul back in time and whiplashed it with the worst case of déjà vu he had ever experienced.
The bad news was that the producers of this stupid survival game show had for some reason chosen to target him.
The robot arms meant to fit his Nexis Suit glitched, and now he couldn't communicate with their damned system. To make matters worse, they were painting him out to be some streaking, perverted madman all because the viewers found it hilarious.
No system. No stats. No rewards.
He was stuck in this hellscape with the strength of a human and no way to improve. All he could do was die. And die again. And then die again.
He'd be damned if he didn't piss on every one of their graves.
[Warning.…
secretly-married-to-a-wealthy-husband:
In a carefully planned deal, she became the secret bride of E City’s most domineering man!
Originally, she thought she was just a temporary figure in his life, but she didn’t know…
“Power or her! Take your pick!”
Faced with the elderly man before her, the man said without fear, “I want both!”
Then, she gained three miniature versions of him!
Happiness overwhelmed her from that point forward!
star-odyssey: Join Lu Yin on an epic journey across the Universe, pursuing the truth and tragedy of his past. This is a world of science fantasy where the older generations step back and allow the young to take charge of affairs. Heart-wrenching separations, terrifying situations, all with comic relief that will leave you coming back for more. This is a world where the other characters actually matter, and are revisited frequently as their own lives unfold. Dotting Lu Yin’s path are monumental feats of kingdom-building and treacherous political situations where he must tread carefully if he wants to get to the truth of his history.
summoned-with-an-sss-rank-portal-skill:
William and his college class are ripped from Earth and thrown into Aethel, a world on the brink of collapse. Everyone gains incredible magical powers – except William. Mocked and underestimated, he’s an outcast among heroes.
But William has a secret: an SSS-ranked skill that lets him travel to Aethel’s past. Learning lost magic from ancient masters, he’ll surpass his classmates and become the true savior Aethel needs. But can he overcome the dangers of the past and present to forge his own destiny?
While others studied about the first mage, William could go back in time and see the first mage himself! While others dreamed of seeing a dragon, William could go back in time, hatch a legendary dragon egg and turn it into his puppy. While others used common materials to craft their items, William could go back in time and mine materials that weren’t find anywhere in Aethel anymore.
Is it unfair? Perhaps, but William was not the type of person to not use the powers the universe gave him.
system-bestows-me-with-immortality-livin:
Chen Xun crossed into the vast world of cultivation, awakened the Immortal System, and even received an Immortal beast as a companion.
Chen Xun walked out of the ordinary small mountain village, stepping into the world of cultivation.
Experiencing the prosperous era of cultivation world, the golden age, the era of rule collapse, the dark great turmoil era, and the era when all spirits were silent...
Chen Xun, have no interest in fighting or killing, nor do I want to provoke anyone. I just want to travel the world with Bull and see all the splendor of the world.
the-bee-dungeon: A dungeon core novel. But with bees. A bee dungeon, if you will. Oh, and something about a young man finding his place in the world and maybe learning about the deadly calamity that threatens all of humanity. But mostly the bee thing.
the-fortunate-demoniac-little-village-do:
He was just a common and unremarkable villager, with his face towards the yellow soil and his back to the sky, bullied and despised by others.
However, one day, he suddenly received a heritage of golden advice, and from then on, he embarked on a path of counterattacking his fate.
the-hero-king-reincarnate-to-master-the-:
With the Goddess’ blessing, he became a 『Divine Knight』 and founded an Empire.
As time passed, he grows older, and by the time the heavens called for him to come, the Goddess showed before him, asking for his last wish.
He wished to be reincarnated in the future. He dedicated all his life for his people, he had no time to master his own arts.
This time, he wishes to live for himself, forging his body to the utmost limit.
The Goddess complied with his wish.
In the far future, the King shall reincarnate as the 『daughter』 of a renowned Knight family. And, under some circumstances, she is labeled as a failure of a Knight, however——
「How convenient. I can stand on the foremost line without needing any rank. No better training than actual combat!」
Thus, the legend of the world’s strongest, most beautiful Knight Disciple (♀) has begun—
the-lucky-farmgirl:
The Fourth Brother had squandered his wealth through gambling, leaving their mother in a critical state. To make matters worse, the creditors even asked them to sell Manbao to settle the debts!
In the village, whispers spread that the golden days of the Zhou Family's cherished Manbao were over. Their elderly mother clung to Manbao's hand, tears streaming down her face.
However, Manbao tightly grasped a system in her hand, a tool that would lead her and her brothers and sisters-in-law to reclaim their fortunes. They ventured into agriculture, cultivating land, growing medicinal herbs, and establishing shops, steadily improving their lives.
As their situation improved, concerns shifted to Manbao's marital prospects by the sister-in-laws.
“Mr. Zhuang's grandson is an excellent match – educated and well-spoken. He is just perfect for you.”
“No! You should consider Mr. Qian's youngest son, who is handsome and well-mannered. You can count on him never to defy you.”
Suppressing a smile, Manbao responded, “My heart is already set. I choose Bai Shanbao, my childhood friend whom I've playfully scolded since we were young.”
the-response-to-my-drunken-proposal-was-:
Despite gifted with extraordinary talent, I resented my life being cut short.
One day, fueled by alcohol, I penned a proposal letter to a princess, hoping to alter my fate.
[Sure. I’d love to marry you.]
…What? She’s accepting?
The problem is, I proposed to all five tyrant princesses.
And to make matters worse, I have no clue which one responded.
to-be-a-power-in-the-shadows: Just like how everyone adored heroes in their childhood, a certain young man adored those powers hidden in shadows. After hiding his strength and living the mediocre life of a mob character by day while undergoing frenzied training by night, he finally reincarnates into a different world and gains ultimate power. The young man who is only playing at being a power in the shadows, his misunderstanding subordinates, and a giant organization in the shadows that gets trampled…. This is the story of a young boy who had adored powers in shadows possibly eventually reigning over the world of shadows in another world.
top-notch-master-masquerading-as-cannon-:
The little snow fairy Tan Mo was about to complete her transformation into a human when she was picked away and reincarnated as the Tan family’s beloved daughter. Only then did she realize that she had become the tragic cannon fodder who died a miserable death after serving as her green tea cousin’s stepping stone for marrying We Keli, and whose life she had once seen before in her master’s mortal world mirror.
Her parents seemingly aged overnight, and her three older brothers all suffered ignominy after their attempts to seek revenge for her. Yet with her here in this life, nobody should even think about harming her family! Tan Mo: Wanna play green tea with me? I’ll give you a taste of master level green tea art today!
Reporter: Young Master Wei, what do you admire the most about your wife? Wei Zhiqian: She’s kind, cute, pure-hearted, and unpretentious.
Reporter: Director Tan, your new work has been praised as a masterpiece. How did you create such an amazing script? Older brother Tan: There’s nothing of the sort. Truthfully, I didn’t write the script. It’s just that the true author is too low key to reveal her true identity.…
top-tier-perversion-dual-cultivate-secre:
Cultivation returns to the world of iron and steam.
Beneath the rich aristocracy are the undercurrents of fog and decay.
Vincent is a transmigrator with a system he finds accursed and useless about which it insists it isn’t.
Still, it feels there are no cheats.
Life is hard, he is short, and women scare him.
Amidst such difficulties, problems only pile up when he realizes women are not going to throw themselves at him!
What do you mean he has to talk to women and form meaningful connections and build trust and give in to their tantrums and fulfill their desires and provide security and validate them and—
*Fuuuuuuuuuuuu*
*Inhale*
*Exhale*
The sacred arts of dual cultivation is limited to a single sect formed purely by female cultivators. What’s worse… It's long been destroyed.
How exactly will Vincent be able to dual cultivate?
How exactly is he supposed to survive with Fate running after him to shove a golden rod up his a*s?
It’s an unstable world with constant infighting between monarchy vs theocracy vs cultivators.
Different races are fighting for their survival.…
touch-of-flame:
He is a threat to her existence.
A hot-blooded dragon of Royal blood, King Malachi is taken hostage by the humans he despises so much. Deprived of his freedom, he is imprisoned in a dark cave, his rage growing with each day of torture and humiliation. The only light he sees comes in the form of a human female, offering her care. A woman who makes him burn with equal fury and desire. A woman who has no place in his heart or mind, for only one thought sustains him.
Vengeance! And even if her kindness softens his heart and her touch sets his body aflame, she will not be spared his wrath. Because once he breaks the chains of slavery, he will burn down her whole world.
She is the key to his freedom.
The cold-hearted princess Ravina is a woman with a mission. Eradicate the dragon race from the face of earth. But when she finds out that the very creatures who killed her parents could also be the ones who kidnapped her sister, she has no choice but to change her plans.
To find her sister, she must get closer to the creature she despises. But things don’t always go as planned and soon Ravina ends up finding more than she bargained for.…
where-immortals-once-walked: Three thousand years ago, a Heavenly Demon ravaged the world until immortals banished it. But the victory was fleeting—spiritual energy faded, immortals vanished, and the demon, cloaked as a god, crept back into human affairs. A century and a half ago, a mysterious artifact fell, turning the thriving Chipa Plateau and the legendary Coiling Dragon Ancient City into desolate ruins. Now, I step into this fractured world, driven to unearth the immortals’ secrets, defy a cursed fate, and expose the truth behind gods and demons. My journey starts in the ashes of Coiling Dragon, where history’s ghosts whisper of epic battles and hidden truths.
